spec_family.name: New Construction Built-In Millwork Painting
spec_family.description: Combined prime+paint spec for residential built-in millwork in new construction: bookcases, entertainment centers, window seats, display niches, and similar fixed cabinetry (excluding closet shelving and kitchen/bathroom cabinets). Uses Opening Count quantification method from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0 — carcass work measured in EA by tier (S/M/L/XL) with three PaintScope modifiers (depth, detail, access). Separate workflow for door/drawer fronts: removed, painted flat on sawhorses, cured 5-7 days, reinstalled. 5 paintable items in 2 task groups: openings (ITM_OPENING_S/M/L/XL reused from closet shelf, EA_OPENING UOM) and doors (ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR new, EA UOM). Substrate-driven primer selection for bare substrates; primer conditional on substrate_state. QT-driven finish systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Localized protection (floor_workzone for spray, floor_perimeter for brush) — discrete elements, not room-spanning. Material systems are QT-driven recommendations — contractor retains discretion.

includes: Residential built-in millwork painting: bookcases, entertainment centers, window seats, display niches, mudroom cubbies, built-in desks/hutches, media walls
Interior compartment painting by opening tier (S/M/L/XL) including sides, top, bottom, back panel, shelves, dividers
Face frame and exterior surface painting (bundled with opening rates via DETAIL modifier for v1)
Door and drawer front removal, flat painting on sawhorses, and reinstallation
Hardware removal (hinges, knobs, pulls, catches, shelf pins) and reinstallation
Surface prep per substrate and item type (dust removal, sanding per substrate state)
MDF edge sealing with solvent-based sealer (bare MDF only — step 1 of two-step prime)
Fastener hole filling and sanding (high density in NC built-ins — 3-5x standard consumption)
Caulking at built-in-to-wall junctions and visible interior joints
Primer coat — conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE (substrate-driven chemistry)
Finish coat application (spray or brush) — 2 coats standard, 3+ at QT5 brush per FFD SS15.10.3
Between-coat interstage process (inspect, sand, repair, clean) at ALL quality tiers
Floor protection (perimeter for brush, localized workzone for spray including sawhorse area)
Wall adjacent masking when spraying near finished surfaces
Ceiling fixture masking near spray work area

excludes.item: Kitchen and bathroom cabinets (unique protection requirements — countertops, appliances, backsplash)

excludes.route_to: Not a painting scope — specialty finish
Not fixed millwork — not in scope

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, sanding discipline, repair scope, and coat count.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2 prohibited — prominent millwork per Millwork Doctrine SS6.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for primer and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray preferred for complex interiors — reaches all compartment surfaces uniformly. Brush for occupied spaces, small scope, or limited spray access. No roll — these are millwork. Brush uses mini foam roller for flat shelf faces (Roll and Tip per FFD SS15.6).

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen. Constrained by quality tier gate.
Input substrate condition. Drives primer requirement and prep scope.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_BARE: full primer coat required (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: skip primer — standard NC delivery is factory-primed.

paintable_items.name: Small built-in opening (6-18" x 6-18")
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each opening counted individually per BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0 tier definitions. Small: cubbies, shoe shelves, small display niches. ~2 SF equivalent for material planning.
paintable_items.condition: When small openings exist in scope
paintable_items.notes: Reused from SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC (REUSE OVER CREATION). Opening modifiers (depth, detail, access) apply via PaintScope inputs.

paintable_items.name: Medium built-in opening (18-36" x 12-30")
paintable_items.counting_rules: Standard bookshelf bays, typical compartments. Most common tier for residential built-ins. ~5 SF equivalent for material planning.
paintable_items.condition: When medium openings exist in scope
paintable_items.notes: Reused from SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC. Calibration anchor for production rates.

paintable_items.name: Large built-in opening (36-60" x 18-42")
paintable_items.counting_rules: Wide media shelving, entertainment center bays, large display compartments. ~10 SF equivalent for material planning.
paintable_items.condition: When large openings exist in scope

paintable_items.name: XL built-in opening (60"+ x 30"+)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Oversized feature bays, custom media cabinets. ~20 SF equivalent for material planning.
paintable_items.condition: When XL openings exist in scope

paintable_items.name: Built-in door/drawer front
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each solid door and drawer front counted individually. Glass doors excluded (not painted). Removed from unit, painted flat on sawhorses, reinstalled after 5-7 day cure.
paintable_items.condition: When built-in has removable solid doors or drawer fronts
paintable_items.notes: New item. Distinct workflow from carcass openings — remove, paint flat, cure, reinstall.

variants.notes: Most common NC scenario. Factory-primed, standard spray. Fastest production variant.
Factory-primed, superior spray. QT5 spray uses 2 coats.
Factory-primed, standard brush. Minimal protection — brush drip only.
Factory-primed, superior brush with gloss. 3 finish coats per FFD SS15.10.3.
Bare substrate, standard spray. Primer + 2 finish coats.
Bare substrate, superior brush. Primer + 3 finish coats. 4 total coats, 3 interstage cycles. Slowest variant.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of small built-in openings (6-18" x 6-18").
Count of medium built-in openings (18-36" x 12-30").
Count of large built-in openings (36-60" x 18-42").
Count of XL built-in openings (60"+ x 30"+).

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: built-in has removable solid doors or drawer fronts
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of solid doors + drawer fronts to remove/paint/reinstall.
Hardware piece count for removal/reinstall labor.
Height modifier for tall built-ins (floor-to-ceiling bookcases). H1=standard, H2=tall room, H3=two-story.
Opening depth modifier: SHALLOW / DEEP / VERY_DEEP.
Detail complexity modifier: SIMPLE_BOX / FACE_FRAME / CROWN_VALANCE / BEADED_ROUTED.
Workspace access modifier: OPEN_ACCESS / CRAMPED / OBSTRUCTED.
Perimeter floor protection at built-in base.
Localized floor protection around spray work area and sawhorse zone.
Wall masking LF at built-in-to-wall junctions.

protection_zones_required.notes: Localized floor coverage around spray target and sawhorse door-painting area. Not full room — built-ins are discrete items.
Drop cloth runners at built-in base. Brush drip and sanding dust protection.
Paper/film + tape masking at built-in-to-wall junctions (sides and top). Protects finished wall surfaces from overspray.
Ceiling fixtures near spray work area. Tape and plastic bag over each fixture.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Built-in meets wall on sides and top. Different finish — built-in enamel vs wall paint. Caulk seals gap during prep.
Floor-to-ceiling units meet ceiling. Not all built-ins reach ceiling — conditional on unit height.
Built-in base meets floor. Floor is never painted. Protection zone covers floor.

valid_input_states.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. SS_BARE requires full primer (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer — standard NC delivery.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Finished walls need masking during spray to prevent overspray.
Brush application has no overspray risk. Built-in-to-wall junction caulked.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection excluded when floor is subfloor.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC may have subfloor during built-in painting.

site_condition_rules.effect: Temperature affects dry times and open time for waterborne products. Cold extends door cure time.
site_condition_rules.notes: Refer to manufacturer PDS for temperature limits. Deep compartments retain heat/cold longer.

site_condition_rules.effect: MDF edge sealing uses solvent-based products — adequate ventilation required. Spray generates overspray. Poor ventilation extends dry times in enclosed rooms.
site_condition_rules.notes: Particularly relevant for enclosed rooms (studies, libraries) where built-ins are common.

affected_tasks: all EA_OPENING tasks (upper sections of tall built-ins)
site_condition_rules.effect: Height modifier via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND: H1=1.0x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Most residential built-ins are H1. Floor-to-ceiling bookcases in great rooms may reach H2 or H3.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Built-in painting is part of the millwork/trim package in NC. Typically painted with or after trim and before wall finish. Same crew, same material system as other millwork.
sequencing_notes.internal_sequence: Hardware remove > Door remove > Prep openings and doors > [MDF edge seal if bare] > [Prime if bare] > Interstage > Finish coat 1 (openings + doors) > Interstage > Finish coat 2 > [QT5 brush: Interstage > Coat 3] > Final inspect > Door reinstall (after 5-7 day cure) > Hardware reinstall > Cleanup.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Floor protection > Wall adjacent masking (spray) > Fixture masking (spray) > Apply coats > Teardown in reverse > Vacuum.
sequencing_notes.door_workflow: Remove doors/drawers (SETUP) → Label and bag hardware → Paint flat on sawhorses (FINISH_COAT) → 5-7 day cure → Reinstall doors (CLEANUP) → Reinstall hardware → Verify operation.

relationships.notes: Built-in painting is part of the millwork detail package. Shares Opening Count method with closet shelf but different PS keys (BUILTIN_SHELF vs CLOSET_SHELF). Built-ins may cause complexity modifier on adjacent wall/ceiling specs — no COMP_BUILTIN exists yet (flagged in research uncertainties).

sections_used: SS4 — Primer Systems (MDF edge seal, FJP stain-block, hardwood tannin-block)
Floor Protection (localized workzone for spray, perimeter for brush)

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Dry times should be specified in specs
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: No dry times in specs — refer to product PDS.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Material system selection is mandatory doctrine
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Waterborne alkyds have longer open time
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Both Advance (waterborne alkyd) and Emerald Urethane (acrylic-urethane enamel) have SHORT working times.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC built-in millwork painting (Spec #17). Key features: Opening Count quantification (EA by tier S/M/L/XL) from BuiltIns Quantification System v2.0, 5 paintable items in 2 task groups (4 reused ITM_OPENING_* + 1 new ITM_BUILTIN_DOOR), combined prime+paint with conditional primer (substrate-driven), 3 PaintScope opening modifiers (depth 1.0-1.50x, detail 1.0-1.35x, access 1.0-1.30x), door/drawer removal + flat painting + 5-7 day cure + reinstall workflow, hardware removal/reinstall, 4 configuration dimensions, 4 protection zones, 35 SOP tasks across 7 modules (26 binary + 9 qt_scaled), 3 round configurations, 9 variants. All 8 material system IDs reuse existing entries. 6 proposed PaintScope keys. 24 registry additions proposed. QA: pass_with_warnings (5 minor, 0 blockers).
